data_description.system_prompt: Optional instructions added to every conversation. Leave blank to use the default.
data_description.context_window: Maximum context your model supports. Check your model's documentation.
data_description.summarization_enabled: When conversations get long, AI Plugin summarizes older messages to preserve memory.
data_description.voice_mode: Shorter responses optimized for text-to-speech. Enabled by default for voice assistant interactions.
data_description.continue_conversation: Whether the satellite reopens its microphone after a spoken reply, so you can answer without the wake word. Always: after every reply. Let the AI decide: only when the reply ends with a question — the model is told to ask one only when it needs your answer. Never: every turn ends after the reply. Close phrases ("stop", "that's all") and the feedback-loop guards end the conversation in every mode. Listen duration is set on the satellite (silence/VAD timeout).
data_description.follow_up_delay: For satellites whose replies play on separate speakers (Google/Cast, Mic to MediaPlayer): the satellite reopens its microphone when its OWN playback ends, about a second before the room actually goes quiet, and records the tail of its own reply. Above 0, AI Plugin takes over — it ends the turn, waits until its reply has finished playing plus a fixed 1-second settle, waits this many seconds, then reopens the microphone itself. 1 second is a good starting point; raise it if the satellite still hears the end of its own reply. 0 keeps the satellite in charge.
data_description.enable_thinking: Let reasoning models (qwen3, deepseek-r1) generate chain-of-thought before answering. Off by default — Assist needs final answers, not scratchpads. Internal reasoning blocks are always stripped from the displayed reply regardless of this setting.
data_description.self_echo_filter: For satellites whose replies play through a separate speaker: drop voice turns that repeat part of the reply just spoken, and fragments of one to three words heard while a speaker in the room was still playing it (a command or a yes/no is kept), so a follow-up does not loop on the reply. Mostly needed with a quiet gap of 0: above 0, AI Plugin reopens the microphone only once the room is quiet.
data_description.timer_announce: Voice timers are announced through Mic to MediaPlayer (or assist_satellite.announce) at expiry instead of ringing on the satellite. For satellites whose own speaker is silenced. Note: the device shows no timer LEDs in this mode.
data_description.find_phone: "Where is my phone?" rings the phone loudly, also on silent: Android speaks through the alarm channel at full volume, an iPhone plays a critical alert (allow Critical Alerts in the Home Assistant app). Only phones running the Home Assistant app and linked to a person can ring. "My phone" is the speaker's when voice recognition knows them; otherwise AI Plugin asks whose.
data_description.feedback_loop_devices: Satellites whose TTS plays through a separate speaker re-hear their own reply and re-trigger listening. Conversations on listed devices always end after one turn; all others honour the follow-up toggle.
data_description.keep_alive: How long Ollama keeps the model in VRAM after a request. Empty = server default (5m). Use -1 for always loaded.
data_description.prune_tool_schemas: Drop unlikely discovery tools per message. Saves a few hundred tokens but defeats Ollama's prompt caching — leave off for lower latency.
data_description.response_timeout: How long to wait for the AI before giving up.
data_description.temperature: Controls randomness. Lower = more focused, higher = more creative. Leave blank to use the model’s default.
data_description.top_p: Nucleus sampling threshold. Leave blank to use the model’s default.
data_description.max_tokens: Maximum number of tokens in the AI’s response. 0 or blank = no limit.
data_description.location_bias: When the AI asks about local weather, nearby events, or restaurants here, the plugin scopes the web search to your home area instead of letting the model guess. Turn off to keep coordinates off the network.
data_description.location_entity: Use this entity’s coordinates as your live location (zone, device tracker, or person). Leave blank to use Home Assistant’s home coordinates.
data_description.use_ha_mcp: Gives AI Plugin access to your sensors, devices, and automations via HA’s built-in MCP server.
data_description.ha_mcp_token: Create one in your HA profile → Long-lived access tokens (scroll to the bottom of the page).

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the provider. Check that your AI provider is running.

error.searxng_unreachable: Could not reach your SearXNG instance. Check the URL.

mcp_add_ha.title: Add Home Assistant MCP Server
mcp_add_ha.description:
Detected HA URL: {ha_mcp_url}

Create a Long-lived access token in your HA profile (Settings → scroll to the bottom of your profile page).

data_description.ha_mcp_token: Required. Paste the token from your HA profile here.

mcp_add_preset.title: Add a popular MCP server
mcp_add_preset.description: Select a server to add. Clock and Web reader work instantly with no setup. SQLite will ask for a database file path.

mcp_preset_config.title: {preset_label}
mcp_preset_config.description: Enter the {config_label} for this server. Example: {example}

data_description.preset_value: Must be an absolute path accessible to Home Assistant.

mcp_add_http.title: Add HTTP MCP Server
mcp_add_http.description:
For Home Assistant's built-in MCP endpoint:
  URL: http://YOUR-HA-IP:8123/api/mcp
  Token: create a Long-lived access token in your HA profile (bottom of the page).

data_description.mcp_token: Required for HA's MCP endpoint. Leave blank for unauthenticated servers.

mcp_add_stdio.title: Add stdio MCP Server
mcp_add_stdio.description:
Runs a local MCP tool as a subprocess.
Example: command = uvx   args = mcp-server-time

data_description.mcp_command: The executable to run (e.g. uvx, npx, python).
data_description.mcp_key_env: Environment variable the server reads its key from (see the server's documentation), e.g. BRAVE_API_KEY.
data_description.mcp_key: Optional. Leave empty if the server needs no key; clear it to remove a saved key.

data_description.mcp_token: Leave blank to remove an existing token.

voice_id.title: Voice recognition
voice_id.description:
Recognises who is speaking on voice turns that reach the AI, so each person gets their own memory. Only voice fingerprints are stored, never audio. It is not a security feature and never authorises actions.

{status}

voice_id_settings.title: Voice recognition settings
voice_id_settings.description: Turning this on downloads the voice model once (about 13 MB) and switches this integration's Assist pipelines to a speech-to-text pass-through that keeps a copy of each command's audio in memory for 30 seconds. Turning it off switches them back.

data.voice_id_voice_enroll: Allow starting enrollment by voice ("learn my voice, I am Anna")
data.voice_id_margin: Minimum lead over the next person

data_description.voice_id_threshold: Higher means fewer wrong names and more 'unknown'. Default 0.35.
data_description.voice_id_margin: How clearly the best match must beat the second. Default 0.10.

voice_id_enroll.title: Enroll a voice
voice_id_enroll.description: Choose who is enrolling and where. The satellite then introduces itself and asks eight short questions. Answer each in a full sentence; nothing said is carried out as a command. Say "stop" to end early. Repeat on a satellite of another type (for example the bathroom) for better recognition there.

voice_id_delete.title: Delete a voice
voice_id_delete.description: Removes every stored voice fingerprint of this person. Their memory is kept.
